route_base.caveat: Resident is slot presence, not DMA completion. A mixed batch guards all its kernels on the missing payload event. This is scheduling exposure, not a measured time saving.

route_split.caveat: Resident is slot presence, not DMA completion. A mixed batch guards all its kernels on the missing payload event. This is scheduling exposure, not a measured time saving.

diagnostics.caveat: One instrumented pair, six blocks per variant. Not timing promotion evidence. Kernel/copy overlap contends for shared resources; kernel union can grow. Uncovered is absence of recorded tasks, not device utilization. VTune wrapper memory is not the model process peak.

default: AILA_Q4E_SMALL_ROWS_RESIDENT_SPLIT remains false. Only ALU expert-major2..4 rows with demand microbatch enabled. No new USM allocation, CPU expert work or production MTP integration.
